    @asynccontextmanager
    async def lifespan(app):
        """Keep V1.5 contract tests separate from real V1.6 identity acceptance."""
        import astroagent.main as main
        import astroagent.services as services
    
        repository = None
        app.state.conversation_service = app.state.repository = app.state.identity = None
        try:
            settings = LocalSettings()
            repository = main.PostgresRepository(settings)
            repository.initialize()
            app.state.conversation_service = services.compose(repository, settings)
            app.state.repository = repository
        except Exception as exc:
            app.state.storage_code = (
                exc.error.code if isinstance(exc, ServiceError) else "database_configuration_invalid"
            )
            if repository is not None:
                repository.close()
        try:
            yield
        finally:
            service = app.state.conversation_service

    @asynccontextmanager
    async def lifespan(app):
        """Keep V1.5 contract tests separate from real V1.6 identity acceptance."""
        import astroagent.main as main
        import astroagent.services as services
    
        repository = None
        app.state.conversation_service = app.state.repository = app.state.identity = None
        try:
            settings = LocalSettings()
            repository = main.PostgresRepository(settings)
            repository.initialize()
            app.state.conversation_service = services.compose(repository, settings)
            app.state.repository = repository

    @asynccontextmanager
    async def lifespan(app):

    @asynccontextmanager
    async def lifespan(app):
        """Keep V1.5 contract tests separate from real V1.6 identity acceptance."""
        import astroagent.main as main
        import astroagent.services as services
    
        repository = None

app = <fastapi.applications.FastAPI object at 0x70ff4a5085c0>

    @asynccontextmanager
    async def lifespan(app):
        """Keep V1.5 contract tests separate from real V1.6 identity acceptance."""
        import astroagent.main as main
        import astroagent.services as services
    
        repository = None
        app.state.conversation_service = app.state.repository = app.state.identity = None
        try:
            settings = LocalSettings()
            repository = main.PostgresRepository(settings)
            repository.initialize()
            app.state.conversation_service = services.compose(repository, settings)
            app.state.repository = repository
        except Exception as exc:
            app.state.storage_code = (
                exc.error.code if isinstance(exc, ServiceError) else "database_configuration_invalid"
            )
            if repository is not None:
                repository.close()
        try:
            yield
        finally:
            service = app.state.conversation_service

app = <fastapi.applications.FastAPI object at 0x70ff4a5085c0>

    @asynccontextmanager
    async def lifespan(app):
        """Keep V1.5 contract tests separate from real V1.6 identity acceptance."""
        import astroagent.main as main
        import astroagent.services as services
    
        repository = None
        app.state.conversation_service = app.state.repository = app.state.identity = None
        try:
            settings = LocalSettings()
            repository = main.PostgresRepository(settings)
            repository.initialize()
            app.state.conversation_service = services.compose(repository, settings)
            app.state.repository = repository
        except Exception as exc:
            app.state.storage_code = (
                exc.error.code if isinstance(exc, ServiceError) else "database_configuration_invalid"
            )
            if repository is not None:
                repository.close()
        try:
            yield
        finally:
            service = app.state.conversation_service

app = <fastapi.applications.FastAPI object at 0x70ff4a5085c0>

    @asynccontextmanager
    async def lifespan(app):
        """Keep V1.5 contract tests separate from real V1.6 identity acceptance."""
        import astroagent.main as main
        import astroagent.services as services
    
        repository = None
        app.state.conversation_service = app.state.repository = app.state.identity = None
        try:
            settings = LocalSettings()
            repository = main.PostgresRepository(settings)
            repository.initialize()
            app.state.conversation_service = services.compose(repository, settings)
            app.state.repository = repository
        except Exception as exc:
            app.state.storage_code = (
                exc.error.code if isinstance(exc, ServiceError) else "database_configuration_invalid"
            )
            if repository is not None:
                repository.close()
        try:
            yield
        finally:
            service = app.state.conversation_service

app = <fastapi.applications.FastAPI object at 0x70ff4a5085c0>

    @asynccontextmanager
    async def lifespan(app):
        """Keep V1.5 contract tests separate from real V1.6 identity acceptance."""
        import astroagent.main as main
        import astroagent.services as services
    
        repository = None
        app.state.conversation_service = app.state.repository = app.state.identity = None
        try:
            settings = LocalSettings()
            repository = main.PostgresRepository(settings)
            repository.initialize()
            app.state.conversation_service = services.compose(repository, settings)
            app.state.repository = repository
        except Exception as exc:
            app.state.storage_code = (
                exc.error.code if isinstance(exc, ServiceError) else "database_configuration_invalid"
            )
            if repository is not None:
                repository.close()
        try:
            yield
        finally:
            service = app.state.conversation_service

    @asynccontextmanager

    @asynccontextmanager
    async def lifespan(app):
        """Keep V1.5 contract tests separate from real V1.6 identity acceptance."""
        import astroagent.main as main
        import astroagent.services as services
    
        repository = None
        app.state.conversation_service = app.state.repository = app.state.identity = None
        try:
            settings = LocalSettings()
            repository = main.PostgresRepository(settings)
            repository.initialize()
            app.state.conversation_service = services.compose(repository, settings)
            app.state.repository = repository
        except Exception as exc:
            app.state.storage_code = (
                exc.error.code if isinstance(exc, ServiceError) else "database_configuration_invalid"
            )

                repository.close()
        try:
            yield
